integrity: The analytical proof is contained in RESULT.md. Finite mesh calculations are corroborative, not a proof for real clipping parameters or arbitrary dimension. No third-party validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact uniform-corner truncation, dimension at least three, and depths strictly between zero and one; does not classify individual Fourier zeros, spectral-set property, noninteger frequencies or alternative lattices. Historical priority remains provisional, particularly with respect to general polytope Fourier transform constructions and older multicover theory.
title: Three-level lattice overlaps and a dimension-sharp Fourier-energy cusp for corner-truncated hypercubes
